annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei nº 6211/2023 - Altera o Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente e o Código Penal para criminalizar conteúdo erótico e pornográfico gerado por inteligência artificial a partir do rosto de crianças, adolescentes e vítimas
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 6211/2023 - Amending the Child and Adolescent Statute and the Penal Code to criminalize AI-generated erotic and pornographic content using the faces of children, adolescents and victims
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill PL 6211/2023 amends the Child and Adolescent Statute and the Penal Code to criminalize creating or selling AI-generated sexual or pornographic images and videos using the face of a child, adolescent or non-consenting victim. It targets AI deepfake abuse and protects children and women. It does not address robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds a paragraph to ECA art. 241 punishing development or sale of AI-generated sexual content using a minor's face (4-8 years imprisonment).
Adds §3 to Penal Code art. 218 extending the same penalties to AI-generated sexual content using a victim's face without consent.
Justification stresses protecting children, adolescents and women's dignity and privacy.
